description_en: The RestartContainerGroup operation restarts an ECI instance
kebab_example: aliyun eci restart-container-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartContainerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECI instance. This is also the ID of the container group
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
